note: synthetic: true. Captured once from the real POST /api/v1/crop-comparisons in RUNTIME_MODE=synthetic against the seeded catalogue on 2026-10-30. Catalogue content is T06b output (rules/evidence pending review); prices are a farmer assumption in the second fixture, never a market observation.

data.rankingBasis: Screening outcome first, then number of known dimensions, then a weighted mean over known water-fit, time and evidence-quality values (tie-break only; not shown as a score). Unknown dimensions are never scored as zero.
